figures.ask_en: What are the rows and columns of this plate grid?
figures.ask_zh: 這個培養盤矩陣的行與列各是什麼？
figures.a_en: Eight square agar plates, photographed on harvest day, day 13. The top row is 0 millimolar trehalose and the bottom row is 5 millimolar. The columns are 0, 75, 100 and 150 millimolar NaCl. Seedlings shrink sharply from left to right in both rows, which is the salt dose response; the question the figure is set up to answer is whether the bottom row holds up better than the top at each salt level.
figures.a_zh: 八個方形洋菜培養盤，在收樣日第 13 天拍攝。上排是 0 毫莫耳海藻糖，下排是 5 毫莫耳。四個欄位分別是 0、75、100、150 毫莫耳 NaCl。兩排的幼苗都從左到右明顯變小，這是鹽的劑量反應；而這張圖要回答的問題是：在每一個鹽濃度下，下排有沒有撐得比上排好。
kw_zh: 上下排是海藻糖 0 與 5 mM
欄位是 NaCl 0 到 150 mM
figures.q_en: What varies down the rows of this plate grid?
figures.q_zh: 這個培養盤矩陣的「上下兩排」變動的是什麼？
opt_en: Trehalose: 0 mM on top and 5 mM below
Treatment timing: pre-treatment on top and post-treatment below
Temperature: 22 degrees on top and 37 degrees below
Protectant: ACC deaminase on top and BoPep4 below
opt_zh: 海藻糖：上排 0 mM，下排 5 mM
施用時機：上排前處理，下排後處理
溫度：上排 22 度，下排 37 度
保護劑：上排 ACC 去胺酶，下排 BoPep4
figures.trap_en: Reading a plate grid without saying which way the dose runs. Always name the rows and the columns before the conclusion.
figures.trap_zh: 讀培養盤矩陣卻不講清楚劑量往哪個方向跑。先把行與列講出來，再講結論。

figures.ask_en: What are the four panels, and what does the red box mark?
figures.ask_zh: 這四個子圖是什麼？紅框標的是什麼？
figures.a_en: The readouts for the same trehalose set: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh-weight normalisation, relative chlorophyll without it, and primary root length. The significance brackets sit at 75, 100 and 150 millimolar. The red box marks 100 millimolar NaCl, where 5 millimolar trehalose significantly enhanced salt tolerance. That is the one condition we claim; we do not claim rescue at every salt level.
figures.a_zh: 這是同一組海藻糖實驗的量化結果：鮮重、以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素、未標準化的相對葉綠素，以及主根長。顯著性括號出現在 75、100、150 毫莫耳。紅框標的是 100 毫莫耳 NaCl，在這個條件下 5 毫莫耳海藻糖顯著提升了耐鹽性。我們宣稱的就是這一個條件；我們不會宣稱在每個鹽濃度下都有挽救效果。
kw_zh: 只有一個條件，不是全部
figures.q_en: What does the red box in this figure mark?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖裡的紅框標示的是什麼？
opt_en: The 100 mM NaCl condition, where 5 mM trehalose significantly improved salt tolerance
The control group, which was excluded from the statistics
A plate lost to mould contamination
The highest salt level tested, where all groups died
opt_zh: 100 mM NaCl 這個條件，5 mM 海藻糖在此顯著提升耐鹽性
被排除在統計之外的對照組
因為黴菌污染而作廢的培養盤
測試過最高的鹽濃度，在此所有組別都死亡
figures.trap_en: Generalising one significant condition into a general claim about trehalose.
figures.trap_zh: 把一個顯著的條件推廣成海藻糖的通論。

figures.ask_en: What is varied across this grid, and why is one plate marked ND?
figures.ask_zh: 這個矩陣變動的是什麼？為什麼有一盤標著 ND？
figures.a_en: Set 9, the main ACC deaminase salinity experiment, trial 1, photographed on day 8. Rows are 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl; columns are no ACCD, pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment. Pre-treatment plates carry the densest green rosettes at every salt level. The 100 millimolar post-treatment plate is marked ND, not determined, because it was excluded for extensive mould growth. TB medium was the negative control, 9 seedlings per condition.
figures.a_zh: 這是第 9 組，ACC 去胺酶抗鹽主實驗的第一次試驗，第 8 天拍攝。三排分別是 0、75、100 毫莫耳 NaCl；四欄分別是不加 ACCD、前處理、同時處理、後處理。前處理那一欄在每一個鹽濃度下都有最密最綠的蓮座。100 毫莫耳的後處理盤標著 ND（未判定），因為黴菌長得太嚴重而被排除。陰性對照是 TB 培養基，每個條件 9 株幼苗。
figures.q_en: Why is one plate in this grid labelled ND?
figures.q_zh: 為什麼這個矩陣裡有一盤標著 ND？
opt_en: It was excluded because mould grew across the agar
The treatment was never applied to that condition
The plate was read but the chlorophyll value was negative
ND marks the untreated negative control
opt_zh: 因為洋菜上長滿黴菌而被排除
那個條件根本沒有施加處理
那盤有讀，但葉綠素數值是負的
ND 標的是未處理的陰性對照
figures.trap_en: Glossing over the ND. A missing cell in a timing grid is exactly what a judge will ask about; say what happened to it.
figures.trap_zh: 把 ND 含糊帶過。時機矩陣裡缺一格正是評審會問的；直接講清楚那一盤發生了什麼事。

figures.ask_en: What is the salt ladder here, and what did the top of it tell you?
figures.ask_zh: 這裡的鹽濃度梯度是什麼？最高的那一階告訴你們什麼？
figures.a_en: Set 5, trial 2, day 12. Rows are 0, 150 and 250 millimolar NaCl; columns are 0, 1, 5 and 10 millimolar trehalose. Root growth falls and chlorosis gets worse as salt rises. At 250 millimolar the inhibition is so severe that two plates are marked ND and the rest carry only tiny seedlings, so 250 is above the useful window: it leaves no room to see a protectant work.
figures.a_zh: 這是第 5 組第二次試驗，第 12 天。三排分別是 0、150、250 毫莫耳 NaCl；四欄是 0、1、5、10 毫莫耳海藻糖。鹽濃度越高，根長越差、黃化越明顯。在 250 毫莫耳下抑制嚴重到有兩盤標 ND，其餘只剩極小的幼苗，所以 250 已經超出可用的視窗：壓得太死，保護劑有沒有效都看不出來。
figures.q_en: What did this figure establish about 250 mM NaCl?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖關於 250 mM NaCl 確立了什麼？
opt_en: It causes excessive growth inhibition, leaving no window in which a protectant could be seen to work
It is the concentration at which trehalose works best
It is the concentration used for every later salinity experiment
It produces the same phenotype as the unsalted control
opt_zh: 它造成過度的生長抑制，留不下任何能看出保護劑有效的視窗
它是海藻糖效果最好的濃度
它是後續所有抗鹽實驗採用的濃度
它產生的表型跟未加鹽的對照一樣
figures.trap_en: Treating a harsher stress as a better experiment. Choosing the dose that leaves a measurable difference is the design decision this figure records.
figures.trap_zh: 以為壓力下得越重實驗越好。選一個還量得出差異的劑量，才是這張圖記錄下來的設計決定。

figures.ask_en: What is this rack, and what state are the plants in?
figures.ask_zh: 這個試管架是什麼？上面的植物處於什麼狀態？
figures.a_en: The hydroponic tube rack after heat stress, photographed from above with its red labels: ACCD and BoPep4 each at 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100, with the controls. Most rosettes are bleached white; only a few of the ACCD groups still carry green leaves. The 'before' photograph of the same layout is on the same page, which is what makes the comparison readable.
figures.a_zh: 這是熱逆境之後的水耕試管架，從上方拍攝，紅色標籤標的是 ACCD 與 BoPep4 各自的 1/40、1/60、1/80、1/100 稀釋，以及對照組。多數蓮座已經白化，只有少數 ACCD 組還留著綠葉。同一頁上也有同一排佈局的「處理前」照片，有這張對照，這張圖才讀得出意義。
kw_en: after heat, same layout as before
a few ACCD groups stay green
kw_zh: 熱處理後，與處理前同佈局
figures.q_en: What makes this 'after heat' rack photograph readable as evidence?
figures.q_zh: 這張「熱處理後」的試管架照片，為什麼能當作證據來讀？
opt_en: A photograph of the identical labelled layout before the heat stress is published alongside it
Every rosette was weighed individually in the frame
The rack carries its own internal temperature logger
The image was taken under a calibrated light box
opt_zh: 同一排、同樣標示的佈局在熱逆境之前也拍了一張，一起發表
畫面中每一株蓮座都單獨秤過重
試管架上有自己的溫度紀錄器
照片是在校正過的燈箱下拍的
figures.trap_en: Showing an 'after' photo on its own. A phenotype picture without its matched 'before' or its control row is not evidence.
figures.trap_zh: 只拿「處理後」的照片出來。表型照片沒有配對的「處理前」或對照排，就不是證據。

figures.ask_en: What is on the y-axis here, and which group is the one to point at?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖縱軸是什麼？要指出來的是哪一組？
figures.a_en: Fresh weight in grams for twelve groups: BoPep4 at 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 with two controls, at 0 and at 100 millimolar NaCl. The six unsalted groups run between about 0.056 and 0.106 grams; all six salted groups are lower. Within the 100 millimolar block, 1/40 BoPep4 is the only group that stays near the unsalted range, at about 0.051 grams, against 0.029 for 0.1 times MS medium.
figures.a_zh: 縱軸是鮮重（公克），共十二組：BoPep4 的 1/40、1/60、1/80、1/100 稀釋加上兩個對照，分別在 0 與 100 毫莫耳 NaCl 下。六個未加鹽的組落在大約 0.056 到 0.106 公克之間；六個加鹽的組全部比較低。在 100 毫莫耳那一區塊裡，1/40 BoPep4 是唯一還留在接近未加鹽範圍的一組，約 0.051 公克，而 0.1 倍 MS 培養基只有 0.029。
figures.q_en: Which group stays nearest the unsalted range under 100 mM NaCl?
figures.q_zh: 在 100 mM NaCl 下，哪一組最接近未加鹽的範圍？
opt_en: 1/40 BoPep4
1/100 BoPep4
0.1x MS medium alone
1/40 WB800 supernatant
opt_zh: 1/40 BoPep4
1/100 BoPep4
只有 0.1 倍 MS 培養基
1/40 WB800 上清液
figures.trap_en: Forgetting the WB800 control. The untransformed supernatant is what separates a protectant effect from a medium effect.
figures.trap_zh: 忘了 WB800 對照。未轉形菌的上清液才是把「保護劑效果」跟「培養基效果」分開的關鍵。

figures.ask_en: What two methods are compared here, and which one was kept?
figures.ask_zh: 這裡比較的是哪兩種方法？最後留下哪一種？
figures.a_en: Four soil pots from above, two methods by two days. The left column is the sub-irrigation accumulation method and the right column is Professor Cheng's top-down wash protocol; the top row is day 0 of salinity and the bottom row day 5. By day 5 the wash pot carries smaller, paler rosettes. The wash protocol produced reproducible salt stress and a visible phenotype; the accumulation method did not, so the wash protocol is the one we kept for soil.
figures.a_zh: 四個土耕盆從上方拍攝，兩種方法乘兩個時間點。左欄是底部灌溉累積法，右欄是鄭教授的由上而下沖洗法；上排是施鹽第 0 天，下排是第 5 天。到第 5 天，沖洗法那一盆的蓮座比較小、比較淡。沖洗法做得出可重現的鹽逆境與看得見的表型差異，累積法做不出來，所以土耕的部分我們留下的是沖洗法。
kw_zh: 累積法對由上而下沖洗法
figures.q_en: Which soil salinity method did the team keep?
figures.q_zh: 土耕的鹽逆境方法，團隊最後留下哪一種？
opt_en: The top-down wash protocol, because it produced reproducible stress and a visible phenotype
The sub-irrigation accumulation method, because it is gentler on the roots
Neither; the soil arm was dropped after this test
Both, alternated between replicates
opt_zh: 由上而下沖洗法，因為它做得出可重現的逆境與看得見的表型
底部灌溉累積法，因為它對根比較溫和
兩種都沒有；這次測試後土耕這一支就被放棄了
兩種都用，在重複之間交替
figures.trap_en: Naming the method without naming who it came from. This protocol came out of a Human Practices visit, which is worth a sentence.
figures.trap_zh: 只講方法卻不講它從哪來。這個流程來自一次人文實踐的拜訪，值得用一句話交代。

figures.ask_en: What kind of figure is this, and what does it tell a judge about reproducibility?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼類型的圖？它告訴評審關於可重現性的什麼事？
figures.a_en: The revised hydroponic workflow drawn as one sheet: seedling preparation down the left, then salinity and protectant treatment on racks. It specifies 2.1 millilitres of 0.1x MS per well at 7 days old, changed to 1.9 millilitres at 10 days, a master mix per treatment from WB800, 0.1x MS, ACC deaminase or BoPep4 and PLP at 1/100 for ACCD only, then 2.1 millilitres of master mix plus 0.07 millilitres of 3 molar NaCl per rack, and seven days of observation. The heat arm runs the same way and finishes in a 37 degree incubator. It is the document that lets another team repeat the assay.
figures.a_zh: 這是修訂後的水耕實驗流程，畫成一整張圖：左邊是幼苗準備，右邊是試管架上的鹽逆境與保護劑處理。它寫明 7 天大時每孔 2.1 毫升 0.1 倍 MS、10 天大時改成 1.9 毫升；每個處理配一份 master mix，成分是 WB800、0.1 倍 MS、ACC 去胺酶或 BoPep4，PLP 只有 ACCD 那組加 1/100；每個試管架加 2.1 毫升 master mix 與 0.07 毫升 3 莫耳 NaCl，然後觀察七天。熱逆境那一支流程相同，最後放進 37 度培養箱。這就是讓別的隊伍可以重做這個試驗的文件。
kw_zh: 每個處理一份 master mix
figures.q_en: What is the point of publishing this workflow sheet rather than only the results?
figures.q_zh: 除了結果之外還把這張流程圖放上去，用意是什麼？
opt_en: It carries the volumes, ages and mixes another team needs to repeat the assay
It is the statistical analysis plan for the chlorophyll data
It records which team member ran each experiment
It is the risk assessment required by the safety form
opt_zh: 它載明了別的隊伍重做這個試驗所需要的體積、苗齡與配方
它是葉綠素數據的統計分析計畫
它記錄每個實驗是由哪位隊員執行的
它是安全表格要求的風險評估
figures.trap_en: Calling it a summary graphic. Its value is that it is specific enough to be followed.
figures.trap_zh: 把它當成摘要插圖。它的價值在於夠具體、可以照著做。

figures.ask_en: What is the headline of this figure, and what do the asterisks mean?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖的主結論是什麼？星號代表什麼？
figures.a_en: Set 7, trial 2: the CH Bio commercial peptide at 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl, as no peptide, co-treatment and post-treatment. Post-treatment gives the most recovery in chlorophyll retention. Panels are fresh weight and relative total chlorophyll in two forms, 9 seedlings per condition, mean plus or minus SEM. Three asterisks is p below 0.001, four is p below 0.0001, ns is not significant.
figures.a_zh: 這是第 7 組第二次試驗：CH Bio 市售胜肽在 0、75、100 毫莫耳 NaCl 下，分成不加胜肽、同時處理、後處理三組。後處理在葉綠素保留上的挽救效果最好。子圖是鮮重與兩種形式的相對總葉綠素，每個條件 9 株幼苗，呈現平均值 ± SEM。三顆星是 p 小於 0.001，四顆星是 p 小於 0.0001，ns 是不顯著。
kw_zh: CH Bio 胜肽施用時機
figures.q_en: Which treatment timing gave the most chlorophyll recovery in this trial?
figures.q_zh: 在這次試驗中，哪一個施用時機的葉綠素挽救效果最好？
opt_en: Post-treatment, applied after the salt stress
Pre-treatment, applied before the salt stress
Co-treatment, applied at the same time as the salt
All three were equal within error
opt_zh: 後處理，在鹽逆境之後施用
前處理，在鹽逆境之前施用
同時處理，與鹽同時施用
三者在誤差範圍內相同
figures.trap_en: Carrying one protectant's best timing over to another. ACC deaminase did best as pre-treatment; the CH Bio peptide did best as post-treatment. They are different figures.
figures.trap_zh: 把一種保護劑的最佳時機套到另一種上。ACC 去胺酶是前處理最好，CH Bio 胜肽是後處理最好。那是不同的圖。

figures.ask_en: What does this timeline specify, and on which day does the stress land?
figures.ask_zh: 這條時間軸規定了什麼？逆境在第幾天施加？
figures.a_en: The experimental design for the ACC deaminase and LEA14 salinity runs. Day 0 stratify at 4 degrees, day 4 grow on to 7 days old, day 11 pre-treatment with three sprays, day 12 co-treatment with three sprays of 75 or 100 millimolar NaCl on the stress groups, day 13 post-treatment, then day 20 after seven days of observation: leaf area, chlorophyll extraction, fresh weight, MDA, total protein and relative gene expression. The salt lands on day 12, which is what defines pre, co and post.
figures.a_zh: 這是 ACC 去胺酶與 LEA14 抗鹽實驗的設計。第 0 天 4 度春化，第 4 天開始生長到 7 天大，第 11 天前處理噴三次，第 12 天同時處理、對逆境組噴三次 75 或 100 毫莫耳 NaCl，第 13 天後處理，第 20 天在七天觀察之後收樣：葉面積、葉綠素萃取、鮮重、MDA、總蛋白與相對基因表現。鹽是第 12 天下去的，前處理、同時處理、後處理就是以這一天為基準定義的。
kw_zh: 前處理第 11 天、後處理第 13 天
figures.q_en: What fixes the meaning of pre-, co- and post-treatment in this design?
figures.q_zh: 在這個設計裡，是什麼定義了前處理、同時處理與後處理？
opt_en: The day the salt is applied, day 12: pre is day 11 and post is day 13
The age of the seedlings when they are moved to the growth chamber
Whether the protectant is sprayed or added to the medium
The number of sprays given, which differs between the three arms
opt_zh: 施鹽的那一天，也就是第 12 天：前處理是第 11 天，後處理是第 13 天
幼苗移進生長箱時的苗齡
保護劑是用噴的還是加進培養基
噴灑的次數，三組各不相同
figures.trap_en: Describing the timings without anchoring them to the stress day. The whole design hangs on that one date.
figures.trap_zh: 講時機卻沒有把它們錨定在施加逆境的那一天。整個設計就掛在那一個日期上。
